title: [Shopify] Fix Get Catalogs tooltip to explain company dependency
summary: The Get Catalogs action on the Shopify Catalogs page now displays a clearer tooltip explaining that it only retrieves B2B catalogs for companies already imported into Business Central.
key_points: The tooltip on the Get Catalogs action of the Shpfy Catalogs page was updated
The tooltip now says the action only retrieves B2B catalogs for companies that have already been imported
If no companies have been synced, no catalogs are returned
The previous tooltip only said 'Get catalogs from Shopify.'
